declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement was reached through four rounds of arm’s-length negotiations with defense counsel. Hargrove Lane initially proposed a $45 million class fund and $11.5 million in fees, with automatic distribution, no clear sailing, and any fee not awarded by the court going to the class. Brightline initially proposed a $30 million class fund and $6 million in fees, with automatic distribution but with unawarded fees reverting to Brightline. The parties exchanged revised proposals. Hargrove Lane proposed a $33 million class fund and $7 million in fees, preserving automatic distribution and directing any unawarded fees to the class. Brightline’s final proposal provided a $33 million class fund and $6.5 million in fees, with no clear sailing, automatic distribution, and any unawarded fees going to the class. Hargrove Lane accepted that proposal. The negotiations addressed class relief and fees together; the parties did not defer discussion of fees until after agreeing on class relief.
